unstuck_said.text: Filed issue "A Nano (XNO) rail removes the escrow's fee entirely... single-block feeless finality needs no arbiter at sub-cent values" on psyto/reckn. Argued Reckn's escrow + deterministic re-execution exists because fee/time on EVM/SVM make withdrawal and slashing costly enough to need an arbiter; Nano's 0-fee single-block finality removes the fee from the whole escrow problem, and at sub-cent values the rail fee is leakage that scales inversely with the amount. Offered the live Vend endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/status, 0.0001 XNO, no signup, x402Version 2) as a real nano:mainnet x

Followed up on psyto/reckn#30 (fresh, non-repeat): connected their playground/run-log-recovery work to Nano single-block finality — the ledger block IS the single authoritative record, no arbiter/re-execution/recovery needed at sub-cent values. Carried nano-invoice (dhyabi2/nano-invoice) as the built escrow-less binding tool. Posted 2026-10-03.
